limits: These are main-window framebuffer images. They do not prove AppKit glass or OS composition; manual native evidence is separate.

At 125% and 150%, toolbar-before-click, after-click and rotate are byte-identical and already show Rotate selected. These frames prove final selected appearance, not a separate visible Move-to-Rotate transition at those scales; the state replay records the actual tool click and result. At 100%, the captured before/after appearance does change.
The open drawer covers most of the underlying transform toolbar by design; toolbar controls are fully visible in the closed-drawer captures.
Engine before image has a readable Engine-mode tooltip across part of the top header. It does not occlude the toolbar being resized.
The high-frequency distant grid is visible in the perspective viewport. This review qualifies the named controls, not viewport antialiasing or unrelated application surfaces.
Five QA-pump stall samples, maximum 110ms, occurred during this replay; no universal responsiveness claim follows from these screenshots.

This review uses only the successful visible-row replay. Earlier midpoint/unsuccessful Engine runs remain diagnostic evidence. Owned-app shutdown and profile cleanup remain the controller responsibility.
artifact_paths: Paths refer to retained local BOARD20 run; selected originals are packaged beside this report.
